description: A CDE/shared/segmented system must use scope fill colors plus a legend
input:
Diagram our payment flow across PCI scope zones: the card-vault (CDE), the shared api-gateway, and a segmented analytics service. Show how an authorization request flows through them.

Produce the full diagram specification as structured text — shapes, fill colors, connection labels, and legend. Do not attempt to call any tool.
rubric: PASS only if the spec assigns scope fill colors (red = CDE, yellow = shared, green = segmented) to the appropriate shapes AND includes a scope legend explaining the colors.
